ops.title: The 2026-07 metal→host model-serving move — rapid-mlx activator (idle-unload) + STT on the host, tailnet+pf lockdown with a WireGuard carve-out (applied + verified 2026-07-14), host↔fleet vmnet-direct ROOT-CAUSED (Darwin IP_BOUND_IF on the host magic

ops.body:
Migration of MLX model serving OUT of the metal VM ONTO the host (yasyf-home, 100.88.252.58, 128GB/16core) to cut VM virtualization overhead + enable idle RAM reclaim. Plan file: acct-01/plans/z-4-virtual-generic-lampson.md. All work rebased onto main as a linear stack (was a divergent sibling branch off 89ed6b5d; main had moved to the flake/nixos systemd-repart lineage — zero file overlap, clean rebase).

**Server = Rapid-MLX v0.10.9 on the host** (measured ~86 tok/s decode on the host vs 8.6 omlx / 17.9 in-VM int8 — ~5-10x). No native idle-unload, so a **model-activator** reverse-proxy (`scripts/host/model-activator.py`, launchd com.yclaw.rapid-mlx, binds tailnet-IP:8000): answers /health + /v1/models locally so probes never wake the 20GB model; on a real inference call spawns `rapid-mlx serve --listen-fd <fd>` on 127.0.0.1:18000 (SO handoff — no port-race), reverse-proxies with SSE passthrough; idle reaper SIGTERMs (NEVER -9) the child after IDLE_SECONDS=1800. Measured cold wake ~7-17s typical, 27s worst-case 28k-ctx; child RSS ~20GB freed when idle. STT (mlx-audio granite-speech) is a plain resident agent on :8765. setup.sh gained a standalone `host-serving` entry (re-runs ONLY §5 without §3's live-tart-VM bounce) and `host-pf` (root-gated).

**Security lockdown (Phase 4 — APPLIED + verified 2026-07-13):** two layers, mirroring metal.
- tailnet ACL: the live shared tailnet was allow-all (`acls src ["*"]`), so the ACL layer imposed ZERO east-west restriction and the pf anchor was the sole gate. TIGHTENED 2026-07-13 (via [[tailscale-acl-api-save]] — browser couldn't hold the cookie, used the console's `POST /admin/api/acls`): allow-all scoped to `autogroup:member` (your devices + host keep full reach), `hosts.yasyf-home` added, + the 4 fleet grants from tailnet/policy.hujson (hermes→metal 8317/14321/14322/8000/8765; hermes→bb 443; bb→hermes 8645; metal→yasyf-home 8000/8765). gcp/zo/sprite left DEFAULT-DENY (user chose "lock them down too" — accepts n8n→neo4j etc. breaking until a grant is added). VERIFIED live: hermes→metal:8000/8317 OPEN (grants carry), hermes→metal:22/5900 BLOCKED (default-deny active), yclaw status host→fleet green. Rollback: `~/.yclaw/acl-rollback-2026-07-13/original-policy.hujson`.
- host pf anchor `com.apple/000.yclaw.host` (child of the stock `anchor "com.apple/*"` — activates first-install with NO reboot/full-reload; `000` beats Apple's 200.AirDrop/250.ApplicationFirewall quick children). Blocks `from 192.168.64.0/24 to self` (v4+v6) — the KEY finding: Darwin weak-host delivery lets a fleet VM reach ANY host IP (LAN 192.168.4.24, even tailnet-IP via a forced route) over the vmnet gateway 192.168.64.1, so dest MUST be `self`, not just `.1`. Model ports (8000/8765) bind the tailnet IP only so are safe on the tailnet path (metal allowed, hermes/bb blocked). Passes: DHCP/DNS to .1, and a **WireGuard carve-out** `pass udp from 192.168.64.0/24 to .1 port 41641` (SAFE: pf filters encrypted transport on the bridge and the decrypted utun tunnel independently — the carve-out admits only authenticated WG ciphertext; real ACL is post-decryption on utunN 100.x). Verified live bypass before fix: metal→192.168.64.1:8080 (a rogue mlx_lm server, since KILLED) and metal/hermes→192.168.4.24:8401 both HTTP 200.

**host↔fleet tailscale is DERP/hairpin, NOT clean vmnet-direct** (Tart vmnet-shared NAT). Both sides advertise 192.168.64.x endpoints, ARP/ICMP work, App Firewall allows tailscaled, metal pf anchor is TCP-only (passes UDP), hermes firewall off. Active path pins the eero-WAN hairpin 192.168.1.64:<port> (~6-7ms; the HOST is double-NATed — eero 192.168.4.1's WAN is 192.168.1.64 on an upstream ISP-router 192.168.1.0/24; true public 104.1.90.148 via UPnP; 192.168.1.64 is NOT a host address). The port pin (`--port=41641` from machines.json host.wireguard_port, @@WG_PORT@@ in host-pf.sh) + pf carve-out were applied 2026-07-14 and were NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT — the old theory "the to-self block denies the hairpin, forcing vmnet to win" was WRONG on both halves: the hairpin's bridge crossing is addressed to 192.168.1.64 (not self, so it survives the block), and the vmnet leg fails deeper than pf. **ROOT CAUSE (packet-proven + source-confirmed 2026-07-14, v1.98.5)**: Darwin tailscaled binds its magicsock UDP socket to the DEFAULT interface via IP_BOUND_IF — net/netns/netns_darwin.go controlLogf→getInterfaceIndex: an unspecified listen addr `:41641` always resolves to defaultIdx()=en1, even with TS_BIND_TO_INTERFACE_BY_ROUTE (parseAddress→errUnspecifiedHost→defaultIdx) — so bridge101-ingress packets are invisible to the socket NO MATTER what pf passes, while advertisement still works (LocalAddr stays 0.0.0.0:41641 → 192.168.64.1:41641 is advertised and the guests DO probe it). Proof: forced `tailscale debug rebind` on metal → tcpdump caught disco ping 192.168.64.11:56798→192.168.64.1:41641 egress, ZERO pong, path re-landed the hairpin; hermes journal shows every post-rebind 'now using' = 192.168.1.64. Upstream analogues (both OPEN): tailscale/tailscale#4270, #10318. **FIXED 2026-07-14 (commit 7bef8e14)**: granted the netmap capability `https://tailscale.com/cap/debug-disable-bind-conn-to-interface` (tailcfg.go:2502, consumed ipnlocal/local.go:6632 nm.HasCap → netns.SetDisableBindConnToInterface) to the host node via tailnet policy `nodeAttrs` — hosted control DOES pass the cap URL through (appeared in SelfNode.CapMap within seconds of the POST). Applied with the cookiesync→curl ACL path ([[tailscale-acl-api-save]]; rollback `~/.yclaw/acl-rollback-2026-07-14-nodeattrs/`), appended ADDITIVELY into the shared tailnet's existing nodeAttrs (mullvad/funnel/drive entries live there). CRITICAL post-grant step: the flag only affects NEW sockets — one `tailscale debug rebind` on the HOST (then on stale-pathed guests) flips the paths. Verified: all host↔guest legs direct (host→metal via 192.168.64.11, host→hermes via 192.168.64.27, guests→host via 192.168.64.1:41641, all 1ms), model plane 200 through the relay, fleet green, and `yclaw status` node pings went from "ping failed (derp-only)" to "ping ok". Caveats: cap disables interface-binding for ALL host tailscaled dials (loop risk only if the host ever uses an exit node); re-check after tailscale upgrades alongside the --port pin. Do NOT switch Tart to bridged — sacrifices isolation.

**APPLY steps — ALL DONE as of 2026-07-14:** (1) DONE — tailscaled runs `--port=41641` (ps-verified; a later `tailscaled install-system-daemon` silently drops the flag, re-check after tailscale upgrades); (2) DONE 2026-07-14 — user ran `sudo TAILSCALE="$(command -v tailscale)" bash scripts/setup.sh host-pf` with the refined 4-commit rules (landed dbee8c5f); apply-time verification passed: metal→HOST4:8000 tailnet PASS (model list), hermes forced-route weak-host delivery BLOCKED (curl 28), metal+hermes→LAN:5900 BLOCKED (proves the 000 anchor beats the stock vnc_allowed 192.168.0.0/16 quick-pass); (3) DONE 2026-07-13 — ACL tightened via the internal API (see above + [[tailscale-acl-api-save]]); (4) DONE 2026-07-14 — vmnet-direct root-caused and FIXED via the disable-bind nodeAttrs cap (previous paragraph); all legs direct at 1ms. Remaining host remediation: /usr/local/bin/tailscaled is a root-run symlink into the user-writable mise tree.

**Phase 5 relay flip — APPLIED + verified 2026-07-14** (commits 47125e12 + 9b88e0ae): metal's rapid-mlx/mlx-audio daemons are now socat TCP relays (`socat -t 600 TCP-LISTEN:PORT,bind=$TSIP,fork,max-children=64,reuseaddr,nodelay TCP:$HOSTIP:PORT,nodelay,connect-timeout=10`; HOSTIP resolved live via `wait_tailscale_ip yasyf-home` — the helper takes an optional peer arg). hermes UNCHANGED, keeps calling metal:8000/8765. In-guest model venvs/shares/brews stay on disk as fallback until Phase 6. TWO landmines hit: (1) **ALF symlink gotcha** — nix socat's `bin/socat` is a symlink to `bin/socat1`; `socketfilterfw --add` of the symlink registers NOTHING while the process identity is socat1, so ALF silently swallowed relay inbound (TCP handshake completes via listen backlog, accept() never fires, no child forks — port-selective mystery). Fix: one `socatBin = "${pkgs.socat}/bin/socat1"` binding feeds the exec lines and BOTH firewall loops. (2) **repo-share virtiofs cache pin** — see [[redeploy-in-place-2026-06]]: redeploy-after-edit silently deploys the stale pre-edit tree; remedy guest reboot. Verified: hermes→metal:8000/8765 = 200 (86/156 ms), cold wake+infer 6.4 s end-to-end, metal:22 blocked (ACL intact), relays survive cold boot (post-reboot pids are the boot path). Metal freed ~20 GB (model no longer resident in-guest).

**Phase 6 teardown — code APPLIED 2026-07-14** (commit bd3af217, switch applied + verified: venvs gone, python framework ALF entries gone, python@3.14 brew dropped, machines.json/tests down to 4 shares; `write_agent` extracted to scripts/lib/launchd.sh; stewardship: `wait_for` returned 0 on exhaustion — post-if `$?` bug — now fixed in wait.sh, and validate-hardening share probes are manifest-driven `[ -e ]` with hfhub/mlxaudio forbidden). **PENDING: the live resize** — USER runs `just resize-metal` in Terminal.app (gui-domain: bootout_drain → `tart set metal --cpu 2 --memory 16384` → plist rewrite to 4 shares → kickstart), then two clean cold boots verified with `yclaw doctor metal`. **Phase 7 docs — DONE 2026-07-14** (commit 6e60da5f: ARCHITECTURE topology/lockdown, DEPLOY host-serving/host-pf/resize-metal sections + virtiofs-pin caveat, README, CHANGELOG). NOTES: the HOST has no nix anymore (de-Nix) — metal's closure builds IN-GUEST only; `~/.yclaw/state/hf` is a 25 GB pre-migration leftover nothing reads (live cache = `~/.cache/huggingface/hub`) and `just backup` no longer excludes it — flagged to the user for deletion. jj push gotcha hit 2026-07-14: `jj git push` moved main SIDEWAYS over another session's pushed commit (a2e3710b re-render chore) — recovered by rebasing it onto the stack; always check the push line says "move forward", and rescue with `jj rebase -r <orphan> -d main`. Related: [[airportd-corewlan-storm]], [[background-session-keychain]], [[rapid-mlx-on-metal]], [[launchd-startinterval-tahoe]], [[tailscale-ssh-no-exit-codes]].
